q: The quantum chromatic number χ_q(G) of a graph G satisfies χ_q(G) ≤ χ(G) (classical chromatic number). The separation between the two is related to:
opts: Non-local games and quantum entanglement: there exist graphs where χ_q(G) < χ(G) (quantum players can properly color with fewer colors using entanglement)
exp: The quantum chromatic number uses entangled quantum strategies in the graph coloring game. Cameron-Montanaro-Newman-Severini-Winter showed ∃ graphs with χ_q < χ. This connects graph theory to quantum information and the study of entanglement.
